zh: 缺乏；不足
en: a lack of something; the fact of there not being enough of something
ex: There was a dearth of reliable information on the subject.
关于这个课题缺乏可靠资料。

zh: 死；死亡
生命的终止；死亡状态
the stopping of biochemical processes of life in a cell or tissue, in a way that cannot be reversed
永久的灭亡；毁灭；破灭
en: the fact of somebody dying or being killed
ex: the anniversary of his wife’s death
他妻子的忌日

zh: 导致毁灭的事情；致命的一击
en: an event that destroys or puts an end to something
ex: They thought the arrival of television would deal a death blow to mass cinema audiences.
他们认为电视的问世将使观众涌向影院的现象不复存在。

zh: a place where prisoners are killed, usually in a war
en: a place where prisoners are killed, usually in a war
ex: This brutal dictator was responsible for the mass murder in death camps of thousands of civilians.
这位残酷的独裁者对成千上万平民死亡集中营的大规模谋杀负有责任。

zh: 死亡证书
en: an official document, signed by a doctor, that states the cause and time of somebody’s death

zh: inheritance tax (= tax that you must pay on the money or property that you receive from somebody when they die)
en: inheritance tax (= tax that you must pay on the money or property that you receive from somebody when they die)

zh: 丧钟；死亡的征兆；预示毁灭的事件
en: an event that means that the end or destruction of something will come soon
ex: If he loses this referendum, it will sound the death knell for his leadership.
如果他输掉了这次公投，这将为他的领导敲响丧钟。

zh: （用柔软物质压在死人脸上，变硬后取出制成的）死人面部模型
en: a model of the face of a person who has just died, made by pressing a soft substance over their face and removing it when it becomes hard

zh: a play (1949) by Arthur Miller that won the Pulitzer Prize. It is about an ordinary man, Willie Loman, who kills himself because his life has been a failure. A film version was made in 1951.
en: a play (1949) by Arthur Miller that won the Pulitzer Prize. It is about an ordinary man, Willie Loman, who kills himself because his life has been a failure. A film version was made in 1951.

zh: 死亡率（某地每年每 1 000 人的死亡人数）
（某种疾病或某个群体的）死亡率
en: the number of deaths every year for every 1 000 people in the population of a place
ex: a high/low death rate
高／低死亡率

zh: 临终喉鸣
en: a sound sometimes heard in the throat of a dying person

zh: 死囚牢房；死囚区
en: the cells in a prison for prisoners who are waiting to be killed as punishment for a serious crime
ex: prisoners on death row
死囚区的犯人

zh: 死刑
en: the legal punishment of being killed for a serious crime
ex: the first death sentence passed on a woman
第一个死刑判决通过了一个女人

zh: the path taken by an aircraft that is out of control and is turning round and round quickly while falling towards earth
a situation that is quickly getting worse, often one that ends in disaster
en: the path taken by an aircraft that is out of control and is turning round and round quickly while falling towards earth
ex: The plane went into a death spiral before crashing into the sea.
飞机坠入海中之前陷入死亡螺旋。

zh: （受命于政府谋杀政敌等的）处决小队，暗杀小组
en: a group of people who are ordered by a government, the police, etc. to kill other people, especially their political opponents
ex: They started forming death squads.
他们开始组建暗杀小队。

zh: 临终；末日；最后阶段
临终的剧痛；死前的挣扎
en: the final stages of something just before it comes to an end
ex: The regime is now in its death throes.
这一政权大势已去。

zh: （事故、战争、灾难等的）死亡人数
en: the number of people killed in an accident, a war, a disaster, etc.
ex: The death toll has now risen to 200.
死亡人数现已上升到200。

zh: 死亡陷阱（潜藏祸患的建筑物、车辆等）
en: a building, vehicle, etc. that is dangerous and could cause somebody’s death
ex: The cars blocking the exits could turn this place into a death trap.
堵住出口的汽车可能使这地方成为死亡陷阱。

zh: a desert covering part of the US states of California and Nevada. It is the lowest land in the western hemisphere, being 282 feet/86 metres below sea level, with very high temperatures (up to 50° Celsius). The desert was a source of the mineral borax in the late 19th century. In 1933, the area became the Death Valley National monument.
en: a desert covering part of the US states of California and Nevada. It is the lowest land in the western hemisphere, being 282 feet/86 metres below sea level, with very high temperatures (up to 50° Celsius). The desert was a source of the mineral borax in the late 19th century. In 1933, the area became the Death Valley National monument.

zh: 死刑执行令
en: an official document stating that somebody should receive the punishment of being killed for a crime that they have committed
ex: The president signed the death warrant.
总统签署了死刑执行令。

zh: （常指无意识的）死亡愿望
en: a desire to die, often that somebody is not aware of
ex: The number of accidents she gets into, you’d think she had a death wish.
她经历了几次事故，你以为她有一个死亡愿望。

zh: willing to face or risk death
that looks very dangerous to do or to attempt to do
en: willing to face or risk death
ex: the death-defying climbers who scale New York City's skyscrapers
攀登纽约市摩天大楼的无畏登山者

zh: 临终床
en: the bed in which somebody is dying or dies
ex: a deathbed confession/conversion
临终告解／皈依

zh: 不死的；不朽的；永恒的
en: never dying or forgotten
ex: written in his usual deathless prose (= very bad)
用他那万世不变的笔调写成

zh: 死一般地；让人想到死亡
en: like a dead person; suggesting death
ex: a deathly pallor
死人般的苍白

zh: 红毛窃蠹（专蛀旧木，发出类似表的嘀嗒声的小甲虫）
en: a small insect that eats into old wood, making sounds like a watch ticking

zh: 骷髅头（象征死亡）
en: a human skull (= the bone structure of the head) used as a symbol of death

zh: a debutante (= a young, rich or upper-class woman who is going to fashionable social events for the first time)
en: a debutante (= a young, rich or upper-class woman who is going to fashionable social events for the first time)

zh: 大败；崩溃；垮台；灾祸
en: an event or a situation that is a complete failure and causes people to feel ashamed or embarrassed
ex: He should take responsibility for the debacle and resign.
他应该对这次惨败负责并辞职。

zh: 阻止，禁止（某人做某事、加入某团体等）
en: to officially prevent somebody from doing something, joining something, etc.
ex: He was debarred from holding public office.
他被禁止担任公职。

zh: to leave a vehicle, especially a ship or an aircraft, at the end of a journey; to let or make people leave a vehicle
en: to leave a vehicle, especially a ship or an aircraft, at the end of a journey; to let or make people leave a vehicle
ex: The ship can embark and debark passengers simultaneously.
该船可以同时上船和下船的乘客。

zh: 降低…的价值；败坏…的名誉
en: to make somebody/something less valuable or respected
ex: Sport is being debased by commercial sponsorship.
体育运动因受商业赞助而降低了声誉。

zh: 降低…的价值；败坏…的名誉
en: the fact of making something/somebody less valuable or respected
ex: He considered advertising a debasement of his art.
他认为刊登广告是对他艺术的侮辱。

zh: 可争辩的；有争议的
en: not certain because people can have different ideas and opinions about the thing being discussed
ex: a debatable point
有争议的观点

zh: （在公共集会上或议会里就某问题进行的、常以表决结束的）辩论
（各自发表不同意见的）争论，辩论，讨论
en: a formal discussion of an issue at a public meeting or in a parliament. In a debate two or more speakers express opposite views and then there is often a vote on the issue.
ex: the first ever televised presidential debate
第一次电视转播的总统辩论

zh: 参加讨论者；争论者
en: a person who is involved in a formal debate
ex: He was one of the most accomplished debaters in the government.
他是政府中最有成就的辩论者之一。

zh: （尤指正式）讨论，辩论
en: the activity of discussing something, especially formally, before making a decision or finding a solution
ex: a debating society at a school
学校的辩论社团
